following is a single-choice question from a Chinese engineering exam. Please select the correct answer.
The principle that the internal audit department should follow for the use of the information system is:
A. The information system is the responsibility of the internal audit department.
B. The internal audit department is the user of the information system.
C. The internal audit department uses the information system based on the requirements of the information technology department.
D. The internal audit department uses the information system based on the requirements of the business department.
Answer:
D

In the 1970s, when China and Japan were involved in a trade dispute over imported Japanese car parts, they did not resort to force. Instead, both sides reached a consensus. The reason was that the Chinese government, as the ultimate owner of the cars, was willing to bear the cost of the import tariffs, thus allowing the Japanese companies to retain their competitiveness on the Chinese market. The Chinese government was willing to bear the cost because:
A. The import tariffs would bring significant economic benefits.
B. The Chinese government is the ultimate owner of all cars.
C. The Chinese government is the ultimate owner of the car market.
D. The import tariffs are the only way for the Chinese government to maintain the competitiveness of the car industry.
Answer:
A
